goalZh: 会用规则动词的过去式讲做过的事,读准 -ed 的三种读音
canDoZh: 能说出自己上周末做了哪几件事,比如"打扫了房间、和爸妈视频、看了一场比赛"

newItems.noteZh: did you 连读成 "di-ja";What did you do last weekend? 你上周末干什么了?
clean my room 打扫房间;过去式 cleaned 读 /kliːnd/。
my room 我的房间;roommate 里的 room 就是它。
过去式 visited 读 /ˈvɪzɪt̬ɪd/(t、d 结尾的动词 -ed 读 /ɪd/);v 上齿碰下唇。
l 不发音;talk to someone 和某人聊;过去式 talked 读 /tɑːkt/。
过去式 finished 读 /ˈfɪnɪʃt/;I finished my homework.。
watch a game 看比赛;美国大学的橄榄球赛、篮球赛是周末大事。video game 是电子游戏。
和家里视频:I talked to my mom on a video call.;video 的 v 别读成 w。
放在时间后面:two days ago 两天前、a week ago 一周前。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Hi, Lei! What did you do last weekend?
lines.zh: 嗨,磊!你上周末做什么了?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: On Saturday, I cleaned my room. Then I called my parents.
lines.zh: 周六我打扫了房间,然后给爸妈打了电话。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: It was a video call. My grandma talked a lot!
lines.zh: 是视频通话。我奶奶说了好多话!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: At night, Ethan and I watched a basketball game. What did you do?
lines.zh: 晚上我和伊森看了一场篮球赛。你呢,做什么了?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: I visited the museum downtown. It was really cool.
lines.zh: 我去参观了市中心的博物馆,特别有意思。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: And I talked to my sisters on a video call.
lines.zh: 我还和妹妹们视频聊天了。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Nice! Did you finish your homework?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Yes! I finished it two days ago.
lines.zh: 写完了!两天前就写完了。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Me too! I studied all day on Sunday.
lines.zh: 我也是!我周日学了一整天。

grammar.titleZh: 规则动词的过去式:加 -ed,读准三种音
grammar.bodyZh: 讲已经做过的事,动词要变成过去式。规则动词加 -ed:clean → cleaned,watch → watched,visit → visited;以 e 结尾的只加 -d(live → lived);辅音 + y 结尾的,把 y 变成 i 再加 -ed(study → studied)。过去式不随人称变,I / she / they 都是 cleaned。-ed 有三种读音:清辅音(k、p、s、ʃ、tʃ 等)后面读 /t/,如 talked、watched、finished;浊辅音和元音后面读 /d/,如 cleaned、called、studied;t、d 结尾的动词后面读 /ɪd/,多出一个音节,如 visited、started。中国学生常犯两种错:把 -ed 读成单独的"的",或者干脆漏掉不读——漏掉了,别人就听不出你说的是过去的事。

examples.zh: 我们看了一场篮球赛。(watched 读 /t/)
索菲亚参观了一家博物馆。(visited 读 /ɪd/)

grammar.titleZh: 过去的问句和否定:did + 动词原形
grammar.bodyZh: 问过去做了什么,要请 did 帮忙:What did you do last weekend? / Did you finish your homework? 否定用 didn't:I didn't call my parents.。关键一点:有了 did / didn't,后面的动词就回到原形——Did you finish…?(不说 Did you finished…?),I didn't call…(不说 I didn't called…)。简短回答:Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.。说"……以前"用 ago,放在时间后面:two days ago、a week ago(不说 before two days)。

examples.text: What did you do last weekend?
Did you finish your homework? — Yes, I did.
examples.zh: 你作业写完了吗?——写完了。
